in_marathi.name: Sharuny
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the Sun and Moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharuny हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharuny is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Shara (Goddess of the Sun) and Rani (Queen). The name Sharuny represents the power and grace of the Sun and Moon goddesses, symbolizing strength, nurturing, and protection.
